# Lectern

Lectern is a native, in-page WebMCP lesson studio at https://lectern.click/.

## Instructions for agents

- Open Lectern in a WebMCP-capable in-app browser.
- Discover the `lectern_*` tools registered on `document.modelContext`.
- Use those typed tools to read or change the lesson. Do not substitute DOM automation when the native WebMCP tools are available.
- Teacher mode registers authoring, validation, media, quiz, and publishing tools.
- Student mode registers read-only lesson, annotation, and tutoring tools.
- If `lectern_*` tools are not visible to the agent, reopen the page through a WebMCP-capable browser or enable Chrome WebMCP testing before acting.

Human-facing documentation: https://lectern.click/
Sitemap: https://lectern.click/sitemap.xml
WebMCP architecture: https://github.com/koha-tech-ltd/open-lectern/blob/main/docs/architecture/webmcp.md
